headline: As of 2026-10-10: 3,093,676 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 34 of 50 states, D+26.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 3,093,676 early/mail ballots cast so far across 34 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+26.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (519,306), Florida (491,469), Michigan (386,495).
